purpose: Record-level seed for the not-yet-implemented combat sync. Captures current post-March-2026 Magic and Ranged ability facts that are stable enough to model without importing boss rotations or settings-dependent calculator outputs.

source_policy.game_values: RuneScape Wiki current ability pages and the archived official March 2 combat patch notes
source_policy.rs_analysis_rule: Use RS Analysis to confirm modeled entities/interactions and later validate calculations. Do not store its displayed sample damage numbers as game constants because they depend on calculator settings and gear.
source_policy.pvme_rule: Do not use stale-warning PvME pages as numeric ground truth after the March 2 2026 Combat Modernization.

magic.name: Sonic Wave
effects: Applies Flow
Flow reduces the adrenaline cost of the next Magic ability by 10%

magic.name: Greater Sonic Wave
effects: Applies Greater Flow for 9 seconds
Greater Flow reduces the adrenaline cost of the next Magic ability by 20%

magic.name: Concentrated Blast
magic.effect: Critical-strike chance applies to the next ability rather than only the next hit.

magic.name: Greater Concentrated Blast
effects: Each hit adds 7% critical-strike chance to the next Magic ability
Stacks to 21% after all three hits

magic.name: Wild Magic
effects: Each hit has +10% critical-strike chance
Each hit has +20% critical-strike damage

magic.name: Asphyxiate
effects: Stuns and binds the target for 3.6 seconds
Completing the channel applies Channelled Might for 3.6 seconds
Channelled Might gives Magic attacks +15% critical-strike damage

magic.name: Runic Charge / Anima Charged
effects: Anima Charged makes Greater Sonic Wave reduce the next Magic ability's adrenaline cost by 45% rather than 20%
Anima Charged causes Concentrated Blast and Greater Concentrated Blast to grant an additional 10% critical-strike chance
Runic Charge is not triggered automatically by Revolution

ranged.name: Piercing Shot
effects: Each hit reduces Snipe cooldown by 2.4 seconds

ranged.name: Deadshot
ranged.effect: No longer a damage-over-time ultimate; it now deals multiple direct hits.

ranged.name: Bombardment
ranged.aoe: target plus up to 9 additional enemies within 2 tiles

ranged.name: Galeshot
effects: Applies Searing Winds for 6 seconds
Searing Winds adds 20% ability damage to each hit from Ranged abilities
Each Rapid Fire hit extends Searing Winds by 0.6 seconds

ranged.name: Rapid Fire
effects: Binds target for 6 seconds
Each hit extends Searing Winds by 0.6 seconds

ranged.name: Ricochet
ranged.effect: Standard Ricochet now includes the old multi-hit Greater Ricochet behavior by default.

ranged.name: Greater Ricochet
ranged.effect: Adds four hits beyond current Ricochet, each dealing 5% average damage.

ranged.name: Corruption Shot
ranged.aoe: initially hits target plus up to 5 additional enemies within 5 tiles
ranged.effect: No longer spreads from target to target; subsequent DoT hits decay by 20% of initial damage per hit.

ranged.name: Death's Swiftness
ranged.effect: No longer creates a stationary ground area or damage-over-time field; the modernized version follows the player.

ranged.name: Imbue: Shadows
ranged.effect: Applies Shadow Imbued; each hit from Ranged abilities against the target generates 5% adrenaline.

rs_analysis_cross_check.note: Presence confirms that these entities/interactions are modeled by the public calculator. Displayed damage results were not copied as constants.
